clusters.headline: Indian Cities Report Severe Air Pollution Following Deepavali
aiSummaryBullets: New Delhi recorded its highest pollution levels in five years, with average air quality index scores reaching the severe category.
Pollution monitoring data has become a point of political contention, with allegations of data gaps and manipulation by various parties.

clusters.headline: Officials Investigate Excess Ethanol Content In Regional Fuel Supplies
aiSummaryBullets: Government agencies in Karnataka and Kerala have begun testing petrol samples at various retail outlets following reports of high ethanol concentrations.
Laboratory analysis in Karnataka identified instances where ethanol blending in E20 fuel reached levels as high as 31 percent.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Police Kill Rape-Murder Suspect In Raiganj Encounter
aiSummaryBullets: A man accused of raping and murdering his young niece was killed during a police operation in Raiganj, West Bengal.
Police reported the suspect initiated gunfire, leading officers to retaliate in what they described as an act of self-defense.

clusters.headline: Fatal Altercation Follows Scooter Collision Incident In Noida
aiSummaryBullets: A 25-year-old man died following a physical confrontation in Noida.
The incident began as a dispute stemming from a scooter collision near Naya Bans village.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Discusses Security Issues During Bastar Diwali
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Bastar region to observe Diwali alongside security personnel.
The Prime Minister stated that while Naxalism has declined, he believes intellectual figures continue to incite populations.

clusters.headline: Fatal Altercations Reported During Deepavali Celebrations In India
aiSummaryBullets: A 20-year-old man in Tiruchi district was killed after being stabbed during a disagreement over firecracker usage.
A special sub-inspector died after collapsing during a confrontation with individuals lighting firecrackers on a public road.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Congress President Kharge Over Recent Diwali Remark
aiSummaryBullets: Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge described Diwali as an 'Eid of joy' while offering festival greetings.
Bharatiya Janata Party leaders expressed disapproval, labeling the comparison inappropriate.

clusters.headline: India And Global Communities Celebrate The Annual Diwali Festival
aiSummaryBullets: Diwali festivities across India include prayer services, traditional rangoli patterns, fireworks, and the sharing of sweets.
Major celebrations were held in Ayodhya, involving drone displays, light shows, and theatrical performances based on the Hindu epic Ramayana.

clusters.headline: Diwali Celebrations Held Globally Amid Reported Seattle Disruptions
aiSummaryBullets: India is currently celebrating Diwali with widespread public participation in religious prayers, lighting, and fireworks displays.
Reports indicate that an event celebrating Diwali in Seattle was interrupted by a group of individuals following a power outage.

clusters.headline: BJP Legislators Make Headlines Following Health Claims And Death
aiSummaryBullets: BJP MLA Papia Adhikari claimed that firecrackers used during festival celebrations can provide health benefits and cure certain diseases.
West Bengal opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari encouraged the use of environmentally friendly firecrackers while following local noise guidelines.
